about: Port Coquitlam is one of Metro Vancouver’s Tri-Cities, at the confluence of the Fraser, Pitt, and Coquitlam rivers. Often called PoCo, it is a more industrial and residential counterpart to neighbouring Coquitlam and Port Moody, with the Traboulay PoCo Trail looping the city. Shaughnessy Street is the traditional downtown. About 61,000 people live in Port Coquitlam.
